about_the_game:
🏆 IN THE PRESS

"Thoughtful, grid-based firefights... where stray bullets can impact the field."

— Turn Based Lovers

🏙️ ODESA 2044

A sun-baked, rusted coastal megacity where corporations play god and districts rot under occupation. Your father vanished into a corporate black site. The trail leads through the Resistance, a fanatical techno-cult, and the Prospect Corp monopoly.

There is no clean side. Only choices, consequences, and a city that remembers everything.

You are not a soldier. You are an Engineer.

Don't play by the rules. Rewrite them.

🔫 EVERY SHOT HAS CONSEQUENCES

  • Stray Bullets: A miss doesn't just disappear. It keeps traveling – shattering cover, igniting fuel lines, or hitting an ally. Always mind your fire vector.

  • The Engineer's Advantage: Cut the power to the entrance, jam the cameras, and lure the enemy into a rigged chokepoint. Win the fight before it even begins.

  • Ammo Economy: Standard rounds are plentiful, but armor-piercing munitions are a luxury. Conserve your resources, or burn them all on one decisive breach.

🧬 DESIGN YOUR FIGHTER

No rigid classes. Your fighter is a system you build from scratch.

  • Gadget-Driven Core: Turrets, drones, mines. Deploy them before the breach and let them do the dirty work.

  • High-Risk Cybernetics: Implants rewrite the rules – advanced optics for range, reinforced actuators for brute force. But every upgrade strips away a piece of your humanity.

  • Learn by Doing: No abstract XP bars. Hack enough terminals under heavy fire, and your netrunning subroutines expand organically.

🏙️ THE CITY REACTS

Every operation reshapes Odesa.

  • District Heat: Made too much noise? Patrol density spikes, safe routes get locked down, and black-market prices skyrocket.

  • Faction Trust: Help one syndicate, and a rival supplier cuts you off for good.

  • Diegetic Narrative: The story unfolds right on your workstation - decrypt intercepted messages, answer calls, and analyze field photos without slow cutscenes.

🎮 DEMO AVAILABLE NOW

Test the core loop today:

  • Story prologue and your first steps in Odesa 2044

  • Full tactical combat featuring bullet physics

  • Early squad customization and loadout prep

📥 Download the DEMO and test your approach.

📡 Wishlist now to join the Resistance and never miss the release!

📋 ROADMAP TO EARLY ACCESS

We are building a massive franchise on the solid foundation of our demo:

  • Narrative Campaign: Acts I–IV, 20+ hours of gameplay, and 5 global endings

  • Living World: 12 reactive districts with faction consequences and micro-endings

  • Clan Base: Deep vault customization and mercenary management

  • Multiplayer [Post-Launch Updates]: PvP Hotseat and online P2P lobbies. The campaign is the perfect proving ground to sharpen your skills for future human opponents.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6500 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 960 — NVIDIA 470+ / RX 460 — Mesa 21.2+ / Intel Iris Xe — Mesa 21.2+
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
linux_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS (64‑bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GTX 1060 (NVIDIA 535+) / RX 580 (Mesa 23+), Vulkan 1.1
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
